mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when sustained for 3 months.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains ≤ 0.1% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to policy response expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) below 0.5% and 0.2% respectively over 3 months indicate real economy contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and GDPC1 declines > 0.2% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline as per trigger.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation that forces aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity liquidity and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 130,000 thousand persons signals robust labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 in a 3-month window indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below 0.3% and 0.5% respectively over 3 months signal weakening demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 0.3% and HOUST declines > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline as per trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
